name: smwmusic-gravity-circuit
title: Gravity Circuit 2 - The Boys are Back! 🔴🟢  ~ Opening Stage (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Opening Stage revealed in Gravity Circuit 2's trailer. I was hyped AF for a sequel to be announced (ft. Cable), and then Ninmark released the song on his YouTube channel, and I KNEW I HAD TO GET MY HANDS ON THAT INTRO STAGE THEME THE SECOND DOMINIC NINMARK DROPPED IT!!!

Gravity Circuit was 2023's GOTY for me, and it getting a sequel is exactly what this world needs!!!

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the voice clip, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (VOICE Enabled)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Disables the voice clip & Decreases the Echo (VOICE Disabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX
ㅤㅤㅤ - P-Switch

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. B Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. A Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. C Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
